_comment: Fixed scenario for `p3-plan.py measure --kind ticket`. The layout and the one already-planned ticket are held constant so that every measured call asks the model exactly the same question: choose ticket T2. Nothing here is built; it is planning input.

tickets.title: Create the package skeleton and test runner
tickets.goal: The repository installs and runs an empty test suite.
tickets.details: Create pyproject.toml declaring the package name, the src layout and pytest as the only dev dependency, per the Setup section of the README. Add tests/test_smoke.py with one trivial test so the runner is proven before any feature depends on it.
